brief: How to have a perfect glow skin — 5 steps from a dermatologist.

slots.subtitle: EXPERT PROTOCOL FOR LUMINOUS HEALTHY SKIN

slots.title: GENTLE CLEANSE
slots.body: Start every morning and evening with a mild, pH-balanced cleanser. This removes impurities without stripping your skin's natural moisture barrier.

slots.title: EXFOLIATE WEEKLY
slots.body: Use a chemical exfoliant with AHAs or BHAs two to three times per week. Smooth, refined texture allows your natural radiance to surface.

slots.title: HYDRATE DEEPLY
slots.body: Apply a hyaluronic acid serum to damp skin immediately after cleansing. Locking in water plumps the complexion and creates that dewy, lit-from-within finish.

slots.title: SEAL WITH MOISTURE
slots.body: Choose a ceramide-rich moisturizer to repair and strengthen your lipid barrier. Healthy, resilient skin reflects light beautifully and feels supple all day.

slots.title: PROTECT DAILY
slots.body: Broad-spectrum SPF thirty or higher is the final and most crucial step. Consistent sun protection prevents dullness, dark spots, and premature aging.

slots.title: BE CONSISTENT
slots.body: Results reveal themselves through patience and daily devotion. Follow this ritual for at least four weeks to reveal your most luminous skin.

slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Book your personalized consultation and begin your journey to radiant, healthy skin.
